name: Mesh
description: Loads file-based GLB / glTF models through the renderer adapter. The system calls `loadMesh` (or, for pools of identical animated characters and for anything with a `fit`, a deduped `loadModelTemplate` + per-entity `instantiateModel`) and emits `mesh.loading`, `mesh.loaded` (carrying the meshId + discovered animation clip names), or `mesh.error`. `fit` sizes a model by height or footprint, seats it on the floor and corrects its authored facing — the knob for a cabinet or a prop whose GLB scale is anyone's guess. `skin` re-textures it. Optionally each frame it makes the loaded mesh follow a sibling MeshPrimitive proxy's XZ position and yaw toward its movement or aim direction. Listens for `mesh.load` to (re)trigger a load.
